name: Admin Document Archive
description: Admin archives documents and folders from /panel/documents, where WHERE (activeFolderId: all | root | none | <id>) and IN WHICH STATE (scope: active | archived | all, default active) are independent axes. The actions sheet offers 'Archivar' (PATCH /api/documents/:id/archive/) and, on an archived document, 'Restaurar' (PATCH /api/documents/:id/unarchive/), whose response reports in `restored_chain` the container folders the backend had to reopen so the document lands somewhere reachable. Each sidebar folder row carries an archive icon (PATCH /api/document-folders/:id/archive/, cascading over subfolders and documents and reporting the counts, behind a confirmation showing the inventory) and a delete icon that is DISABLED whenever the folder holds anything, archived content included, matching the backend 409; both name their action in a tooltip. The delete confirmation for a document still offers archiving as a secondary action, visible and enabled BEFORE the DELETE word is typed. 'Ver archivados' is an explicit MODE SWITCH in the sidebar header, deliberately OUTSIDE the folder list: as a row among the folders it read as one more destination, and nothing declared that the archive is the scope the whole panel is being seen in. Turning it on from Todos lands on the archive root and turning it off from there returns to Todos; from inside a folder it only changes the state, keeping the user where they were. The archive renders as a NAVIGABLE TREE — an archived folder appears as a container, its cascade-archived children are reached by entering it (GET /api/documents/?folder=:id&scope=archived) and the breadcrumb reads 'Archivados › …'. An active folder that still holds archived items shows a badge that opens it in its archived scope. A three-way state filter (Todos / Solo activos / Solo archivados) sits in the toolbar and applies to folders and documents alike; the archived scope keeps its Archivado column, relative age and Recientes / Más antiguos order control (?order=oldest). Search is global — it ignores folder and state (GET /api/documents/?scope=all&search=), visibly moves the filter to Todos and marks each archived hit — and every mutation refreshes the authoritative sidebar counters from GET /api/documents/counts/. Archived items are not drop targets and cannot be dragged. View-sync wave (2026-08-13): archiving or deleting the folder being viewed — or any ancestor of it — retreats the view to the affected folder's parent (fallback Todos) instead of leaving a ghost descendant; selecting a folder or clicking a mixed-state badge DURING a search exits the search and actually navigates (the badge lands in that folder's archived scope); the search shows the list skeleton while in flight and clears stale results on each new term; inside an archived folder an inline alert offers 'Restaurar esta carpeta' (doc-restore-current-folder) and following the restore switches the view to the active scope keeping the folder; folder and scope persist in the URL (?folder=&scope=, router.replace, defaults omitted, transient search scope never persisted) so F5 and deep links rebuild the view; 'Sin carpeta' shows the unfiled_active counter; archive/delete confirmations spin in-flight (waitForConfirm keeps ConfirmModal open and busy) and row Restaurar buttons go inert while a mutation runs. Declared-mode wave (2026-08-15): the scope is labelled in the listing header (doc-scope-banner) whenever it is not the resting one, and the section carries its own tint in archived mode; the sidebar FOLLOWS the mode — it lists the real root folders, so a fully archived folder no longer looks like it stopped existing, and Todos, Sin carpeta and every folder row count what the current mode shows (archived / unfiled_archived); the single-highlight rule is gone, so the folder being viewed lights up again with aria-current=page, archive included; a folder holding nothing archived says so by name instead of falling into the generic empty, and with the mode off an archived folder no longer offers 'create a document here', which the backend rejects with a 400; the URL is authoritative in BOTH directions (a missing param means the default, so a store left over from a previous visit cannot survive a return to the module, and back/forward reapply to the view); and deleting or moving a document leaves the view in the folder it was in, the same rule archiving already followed. Scope-fidelity wave (2026-08-31): the archived mode lists a folder only when it is archived itself or still holds archived content in its subtree — a project with nothing archived disappears entirely instead of showing its whole active tree — and every listed row counts its inventory in the VIEW's scope, not in its own state.
knownGaps: Spec extended 2026-08-13 with the view-sync wave: sidebar lit in archived scope at depth, ancestor-archive retreating to the top, badge-mid-search exiting into the archived folder, restore-current-folder following into the active scope, and URL persistence surviving a reload. Still covered only at the backend layer: the cascade-memory rule (items archived individually stay archived when their folder is unarchived), the chain restore leaving the rest of those folders archived, the guards that reject moving or duplicating active content into an archived folder, the audit_archive_integrity command, and the client portal now excluding archived documents (accounts tests).
